title: A crossing refuses while another ticket's build is uncommitted in the tree
intention: A crossing into BUILDME, PROVEME or PROVED refuses while the cairn working tree carries uncommitted code that is not the crossing ticket's own build, so no crossing is judged by another ticket's unproved build. Own build = the writes_to of the ticket's decompose berth; records (artifact.locate) are never code dirt; back-edges and ticketless crossings stay ungated.
why: Ruling 8t (Akien, verbatim: "yes, but generally we shouldn't allow that.", /home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md): 5bc3a4b1ab27 crossed PROVED with its verdict run by 68cef2ddd8ef's uncommitted, unproved verdict.py still applied in the tree. A green judged by an unproved build is a green no peer can lean on (Law 8), and until a lane refuses it the rule is policy (Law 4).
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass, and peers trust only what is proven: a verdict run by an unproved build is a green no peer can lean on) and Law 4 (Akien's ruling 8t is policy until a lane enforces it). RULE 1: the lane reaches orient, artifact and chain only through their declared public_interface modules.
how: (a) orient.py repo_truth: add one `git status --porcelain -z --untracked-files=all` read and parse it. Each entry is XY, a space, then the path. For an R or C status the NEXT NUL field is the source path, so skip it and keep the destination. Emit `dirty: [repo-relative paths]` per repo row. `dirty_paths` stays the count from the existing read. (b) transitions.py: `class ForeignBuildRed(IllegalTransition)`; a module global `_FOREIGN_BUILD_BERTHS = None` passed as chain_for_ticket's berths_root (the proof repoints it); `inspect_foreign_build(ticket, *, history_path) -> list[dict]` returning ONE `_lane('no_other_tickets_build_is_in_the_tree', expected=..., actual=..., code='transitions.py::inspect_foreign_build', ticket=ticket, foreign=[...], own=[...])`. Measure the toplevel via the existing _repo_toplevel(Path(history_path).resolve().parent). Records are paths where artifact.locate(toplevel/p) is not None. own = the decompose writes_to (empty if no berth). foreign = dirty minus records minus own. (c) a `_foreign_build_gate(ticket, *, history_path)` VIEW like _proof_named_gate that raises ForeignBuildRed naming every foreign path and the ruling. (d) the seat in emit, placed immediately BEFORE the FIXME GATE block: `if target in ('BUILDME','PROVEME','PROVED') and target_idx > wf.cursor and journal_extra.get('ticket') is not None`, appending its record to `proved`. (e) the proof follows test_the_stones_are_pushed.py's fixture: a real git repo in a tempdir, node classes copied, _TICKETS repointed, set_diagnostic_roots for the fixture roots, a fixture decompose packet under a fixture berths root, all restored in finally. PROVES keyed on this ticket with clauses 1-5, one tooth each. Run only via bin/cairn test --netns; PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 300.
falsifier: Done when cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_no_other_tickets_build_is_in_the_tree.py is green under bin/cairn test --netns. (1) In a fixture git repo, forward crossings into BUILDME, PROVEME and PROVED for a fixture ticket each raise ForeignBuildRed naming a modified tracked code file outside the ticket's decompose writes_to, and the history file is byte-unchanged. (2) An untracked code file outside writes_to refuses the same way. (3) inspect_foreign_build reads clean when the only dirt is the ticket's own writes_to files plus record paths (history.json, state.json under the diagnostic roots). (4) A back-edge (PROVEME -> BUILDME) with foreign dirt crosses ungated. (5) repo_truth(repos=[fixture]) returns a `dirty` list holding the modified and untracked paths, and `dirty_paths` is still the porcelain line count. Red at HEAD 4b3ac7f5: no ForeignBuildRed and no `dirty` key. Horizon: this voyage. Wrong intent if a measured legitimate crossing needs foreign uncommitted code applied, for example a parent crossing over its child's applied build.
